purpose: R2 offline measurement of calls per trial for the event-log task; no network, no credentials, no spend
provider: EventLogPreviewTransport: truth-blind constant worker, single-turn no-op improver

derived.per_adaptation_item_offline: 4 worker rollouts + 3 improver sessions + 1 reflection session = 8 calls
derived.final_test_calls: 40 for base + 40 per trial whose retained package differs from base; at most 240 for 5 trials

live_estimate.basis: Inference, not measurement. The 28 Oct live images job (evidence/2026-10-28-live-app/live-report.json) made 117 calls: 14 worker executions, about 102 improver calls over 2 adaptation items, i.e. about 8 sessions at roughly 13 calls each. Live sessions may take up to 12 model turns (spark.py) plus rate-limit retries.
live_estimate.cost_note: Improver cost was about $0.012 per adaptation item on the old task; event-log worker cost is unmeasured until R3.
